gen_risks.description: Construction of the Citizen Service Center (CSC) building in Tirana may cause negative environmental impacts such as noise, dust, and waste generation.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement the project-specific Environmental Management Plan (EMP) integrated into bidding documents and construction contracts.
gen_risks.evidence: Operational policy OP 4.01 is triggered and the project categorized as a World Bank Category B because a new building will be constructed for CSC.

gen_risks.description: Newly created implementation agency ADISA lacks prior track record and capacity in executing World Bank procurement guidelines.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish a dedicated PMU with experienced procurement staff, conduct Bank procurement training, and adopt a Project Operational Manual.
gen_risks.evidence: Since ADISA is a newly-created agency and the PMU is not yet fully set up, the procurement risk rating is high.

gen_risks.description: Lack of experience in MIPA and ADISA with large donor-funded financial management systems creates substantial implementation risk.
gen_risks.mitigation: Recruit two qualified finance specialists, conduct FM training, issue a Financial Management Manual, and install accounting software.
gen_risks.evidence: Neither MIPA, nor the recently constituted ADISA have previous experience in implementation of large donor funded operations...

gen_risks.description: Complex coordination across more than a dozen participating government agencies could stall execution of business process re-engineering.
gen_risks.mitigation: Utilize the Prime Minister's Delivery Unit and Inter-Ministerial Public Services Committee for cross-agency facilitation and strategic oversight.
gen_risks.evidence: Inter-sectoral reforms, especially those that involve more than a dozen government agencies, necessarily entail complex coordination.

gen_risks.description: An overly ambitious and compressed reform timeline may exceed implementation capacities and delay project outputs.
gen_risks.mitigation: Phase implementation activities over five years and incentivize milestone achievements through Disbursement Linked Indicators.
gen_risks.evidence: The Government's timeline for the reform is very ambitious.

gen_risks.description: Focusing on advanced digital e-services and high-end urban service centers risks diminishing service access for poor, vulnerable, and rural citizens.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish assisted digital outreach points, maintain local service channels, conduct targeted outreach, and collect disaggregated feedback.
gen_risks.evidence: ...there is a risk that the focus on state-of-the-art means for service delivery... will diminish access of the poor and vulnerable...

gen_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance from civil servants and line agency personnel reluctant to cede front-office functions may hinder process reforms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Execute internal stakeholder communication programs, change management workshops, and political economy risk management.
gen_risks.evidence: Ministries, agencies and individual civil servants may not welcome ceding the front office function to CSC. Bureaucratic resistance could stifle efforts...

gen_risks.description: Legacy registers across participating agencies suffer from incomplete digitization, missing identification numbers, and legal property ownership disputes.
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide technical assistance and ICT advisory support for database optimization, data validation, and connection to the government interoperability platform.
gen_risks.evidence: The level of digitization of legacy registers and their presumption of authenticity and interoperability differs substantially among different institutions...

gen_risks.description: Delays in contracting PMU staff during initial project setup could delay early project preparation and procurement execution.
gen_risks.mitigation: Assign fiduciary responsibilities temporarily to the Central Financing and Contracting Unit (CFCU) in the Ministry of Finance during the PPF period.
gen_risks.evidence: Except for the Financial Specialist, PMU staff are yet to be contracted due to the delay in the approval of the PPF.

gen_risks.description: Delays in drafting and passing required omnibus legislation could stall legal approval of re-engineered administrative processes.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish technical inter-ministerial working groups to draft legislative changes early and sequence approval through a single omnibus bill.
gen_risks.evidence: Reform of government services and repeal of licenses, permits, and approvals will be implemented through omnibus legislation...

gen_risks.description: Modest national internet penetration levels may limit citizen adoption and usage of newly automated online e-services.
gen_risks.mitigation: Maintain physical Citizen Service Center access points and establish local assisted internet access points in community centers and internet cafes.
gen_risks.evidence: ...there will be a need for a physical presence... given modest levels of internet penetration at only 60 internet users per 100 people...

gen_risks.description: Inaccurate administrative reporting data may obscure actual processing delays and citizen wait times.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement proactive citizen feedback collection via SMS/phone calls and conduct periodic independent user surveys to verify administrative claims.
gen_risks.evidence: Citizens widely complain... that they face lengthy delays... The data submitted by the IPRO office on the other hand routinely records that almost all applications are processed...

gen_risks.description: Institutional weakness and limited staffing in MIPA may undermine long-term sustainability of service delivery reforms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Strengthen ADISA's legal mandate and build capacity within the Prime Minister's Delivery Unit to sustain performance monitoring.
gen_risks.evidence: Insufficient institutional and implementation capacity of the Ministry of State for Innovation itself has implications for project implementation and longer-term sustainability.

gt_risks.description: Institutional capacity poses challenges to delivering the reform effort, despite very high leadership commitment and fast-paced GoA initiation of reforms.
gt_risks.mitigation: The Project Preparation Facility (PPF) is designed to assist capacity building for the implementing agency; the TA part of the loan continues building capacity to deliver, addressing the most pressing capacity needs.

gt_risks.description: Fiduciary risks related to the new form of financial instrument used in Albania.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the fiduciary risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Technical design risk, named alongside the fiduciary risk as being addressed by the same TA support (fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU); not separately elaborated beyond this.
gt_risks.mitigation: The TA part of the loan helps mitigate the technical design risk by supporting fiduciary and budget specialists in the PMU.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risks arising from inter-agency coordination.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by strong emphasis on coordination mechanisms in the design of the operation.

gt_risks.description: Bureaucratic resistance to enhanced transparency and simplification of administrative processes.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated in part through high-level leadership and engagement, and through citizen feedback arrangements that help pinpoint poor performance and corruption.

gt_risks.description: Political cycle risk from elections coming up in 2017, which could disrupt reform continuity and government commitment.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated by making early progress in showing results and ensuring a broad constituency of support for the project's objectives and activities among the leadership of participating institutions and service users.
